info.name: Mark43 Partnerships Associated Records CAD Configuration API

description.content: Mark43's Partnerships (External) API lets approved law-enforcement technology partners integrate with a Mark43 agency's cloud RMS and CAD: create and read reports, persons, evidence and chain-of-custody, attachments, CAD events, warrants, tasks, users, and E911 data. REST over HTTPS with JSON payloads and HTTP Basic authentication using secure API tokens.
